english.title: Permit the use of a vehicle altered to run on leaded petrol
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) designed and constructed for running on unleaded petrol, which had been deliberately altered or adjusted for running on leaded petrol and, as a result, was incapable of running on unleaded petrol
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 39A of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 39B(3) partly defines "fuel tank".
(ii) See regulation 39a(4) for exceptions.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) See also offence wordings: H1010 and H1065.
english.standardstatementoffacts: AT **(..SPECIFY TIME..) ON **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND PLACE..). The vehicle was designed to run on unleaded petrol but it had been altered to run on leaded petrol only.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
